title: Beat the Heat with a Cool Deal: Caesars Entertainment Presents “Caesars Show Week” from June 22-29
summary: Beat the Heat with a Cool Deal: Caesars Entertainment Presents Caesars Show Week from June 22-29 With more than 160 shows available at Caesars Entertainment resorts across the country, please visit Ticketmaster.com/Caesars50 for more info and to purchase LAS VEGAS (June 22, 2026) Caesars Entertainment is inviting guests to celebrate the summer with live entertainment deals at more than 25 destinations across the U.S, including Las Vegas, Atlantic City and Lake Tahoe. Caesars Show Week, running June 22-29, features $50 tickets, with select shows offering two tickets for $50 (plus service fee and tax). The limited-time offer includes superstar headliners to the biggest names in comedy and magic. Resorts participating in "Caesars Show Week" include: Caesars Palace Las Vegas Flamingo Las Vegas Harrahs Las Vegas Horseshoe Las Vegas The LINQ Hotel The LINQ Promenade Paris Las Vegas Planet Hollywood Resort
